title: The global search PR queried MailAccount and MailRule with plain .objects.filter() behind only a model-level has_perm check, unlike the owner-aware get_objects_for_user_owner_aware() it used for tags and correspondents, so users see other users' mail accounts and rules.

findings.explanation: SearchResultSerializer.to_representation fetches a Document by a user-controlled id (instance["id"]) with Document.objects...get(id=instance["id"]) and returns its full contents (content, correspondent, tags, notes) via super().to_representation(doc). The serializer itself performs no ownership/permission check. In the PR the class is relocated from views.py (where it was `class SearchResultSerializer(DocumentSerializer, PassUserMixin)`) to serialisers.py as `class SearchResultSerializer(DocumentSerializer)`. In DRF, `super().to_representation(doc)` resolves to DocumentSerializer.to_representation — NOT to PassUserMixin.to_representation, since PassUserMixin is a ViewMixin (subclass of GenericAPIView/View) that is not in the serializer's MRO. So PassUserMixin did not contribute ownership-checking to the serializer even before the change; the ownership enforcement came from the view layer. UnifiedSearchViewSet (DocumentViewSet) uses `permission_classes = (IsAuthenticated, PaperlessObjectPermissions)`, which authorizes at the request level, and PassUserMixin.get_serializer injects the `user` for the serializer. Because the authorization in this search endpoint is driven by the view's permission class rather than by the serializer's inheritance of PassUserMixin, the relocation to a serializer without that mixin is a plausible regression point: if the consuming endpoint relies on the serializer carrying user/permission context (as DocumentSerializer's permission logic does via self.user), removing PassUserMixin could let to_representation serialize a document the requester does not own. Flagging as a candidate to confirm the consuming view still enforces object-level authorization before serializing.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep object-level authorization at the view layer (permission_classes + ObjectOwnedOrGrantedPermissionsFilter) and verify the consuming view filters/permits the returned document before serializing. If the serializer is expected to be self-authorizing, restore per-instance ownership verification in to_representation (e.g., check that the requesting user owns the document or has view permission) rather than relying on PassUserMixin in the serializer MRO, which does not affect DRF serializer resolution.
